record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: The theory of decompositions of Banach spaces in relation to multi-norms involves orthogonal and small decompositions, using the language of §7.1 of [ 9 ]. Each small decomposition is orthogonal. It would be nice if the converse were true.

evidence.quote: The theory of decompositions of Banach spaces in relation to multi-norms involves orthogonal and small decompositions, using the language of §7.1 of [ 9 ]. Each small decomposition is orthogonal. It would be nice if the converse were true.

artifact.status_search_result: A web search indicates the equivalence of small and orthogonal decompositions has been established in certain settings (e.g. Hilbert C*-modules with the Hilbert multi-norm), but no general resolution for arbitrary Banach spaces with arbitrary multi-norms was located. The status of the general question appears unresolved in the publicly indexed literature.

status_evidence.title: Extensions of the Hilbert-multi-norm in Hilbert C*-modules
status_evidence.snippet: small and orthogonal decompositions with respect to these multi-norms are equivalent (in the Hilbert C*-module setting)
status_evidence.claim: Equivalence is established in a special setting, suggesting the general question remained open at the time of writing.

status_evidence.claim: Provides background on the framework of orthogonal/small decompositions for multi-norms.
